---

Please provide the following:

1. Literature reference (or attachment) which provides a scientific definition. 
2. A scientific definition is a quantitative one, not just words "unit for the amount of XYZ." A scientific definition will also give some way of converting or inferencing something with the values expressed using that unit. 
3. Include document URLs or drag/drop attachments to accompany your request.

Note the scope of UCUM is science, healthcare, engineering, and business (not including currencies). Units outside this context are discouraged. SI units are given priority. If conversion to SI is not possible, then there must be a strong justification, which should refer to the importance of the unit, and the size of the community or application on behalf of whom the request is made.

Be certain to include the unit in the issue title above.
